newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 17.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- The first session of the "Hanbogate" trial will open at 10 a.m. today at the grand courtroom of the Seoul District Court.

- President Kim Young-sam has reshuffled four chief posts of the ruling New Korea Party, replacing secretary general Kang Sam-jae with former chief presidential secretary, Representative Park Kwang-yong.
- North Korea defector Hwang Jang-yop is likely to leave Beijing on the 17th or the 18th to the Philippines, sources said.
- Spain's Abel Anton broke the tape on Sunday to win the Dong-A International Marathon race in Kyongju in 2 hours 12 minutes and 58 seconds.
- President Kim Young-sam's second son, Kim Hyun-chul, is likely to stand as a witness before a parliamentary panel to investigate the Hanbo scandal, sources said.
